raw_translation: Danna kan manufar domin ka yi wata harbi. Danna kan yankin da ba'a da shi domin ka yi wata kuskure.
source: Click the target to score a hit. Click the empty area to record a miss.
translation: Danna kan manufar domin ka yi wata harbi. Danna kan yankin da ba'a da shi domin ka yi wata kuskure.

back_sample.translation: This is a strict DDL change helper, not a database link or change manager. External keys, CHECK terms, attributes, comments, unmarked types and language-related words are not changed. Check and test the language generated on your database engine; keep a backup before applying schema changes.

raw_translation: Wannan wani mai taimakon canza DDL mai tsauri ne, ba wani haɗin tashar bayanai ba ko mai tafiyar da canji. Maɓallan waje, sharuɗɗan CHECK, indiyalai, sharhi, nau'ikan da ba'a sanya alamarsu ba da kuma kalmomi masu alaƙa da harshe ba a canza su. Bincike da gwajin maganar da aka samar a kan injin tashar bayananka; kiyaye wani madadin kafin a yi amfani da sauye-sauye na schema.
source: This is a static, restricted DDL conversion helper, not a database connection or migration runner. Foreign keys, CHECK constraints, indexes, comments, unsigned types and dialect-specific expressions are not converted. Review and test the generated statement against your database engine; keep a backup before applying schema changes.
translation: Wannan wani mai taimakon canza DDL mai tsauri ne, ba wani haɗin tashar bayanai ba ko mai tafiyar da canji. Maɓallan waje, sharuɗɗan CHECK, indiyalai, sharhi, nau'ikan da ba'a sanya alamarsu ba da kuma kalmomi masu alaƙa da harshe ba a canza su. Bincike da gwajin maganar da aka samar a kan injin tashar bayananka; kiyaye wani madadin kafin a yi amfani da sauye-sauye na schema.
